$comment: PUBLICATION ALLOWLIST. This file is the only thing that decides what reaches the public site.
The build never walks a directory looking for documents to publish. It reads this list and
nothing else. A document that is not listed here cannot be published, and a document listed
with "publish": false is imported for link resolution but is never rendered or copied.
1. Adding a page to the public site is always a reviewable diff to this file.
2. Analysis that lives outside the three repositories - for example the Pond Protocol
strategy notes held in the private agent store - has no path onto the site at all.
scripts/guard.mjs additionally fails the build if such material shows up in the output.
See site/README.md for the reasoning and scripts/guard.mjs for the enforced invariants.

site.title: Pond Protocol
site.tagline: Two XRP Ledger assets, one canonical identity.
site.description: Documentation for Pond Protocol: the $PND issued currency, the $rPND Multi-Purpose Token, and the verified issuer identity that distinguishes them from same-ticker impostors.
$comment_domain: The domain is not chosen yet. Set "domain" to the real apex once it is registered - for
example "pondprotocol.xyz" - and everything that needs it picks it up: the {{domain}}
placeholder in authored pages, the canonical and og:url tags, and the sitemap.
While "domain" is empty the site renders domainPlaceholder as visible text so the reader
can see a decision is outstanding, and emits NO canonical or og:url tags at all. A canonical
URL pointing at a domain that does not exist is worse than having none.
The domain must be one you will hold indefinitely. Once the issuer's on-ledger Domain field
points at it, and especially if the issuer is ever blackholed, losing the domain breaks the
token's metadata permanently. Treat its renewal as a protocol-critical dependency.
$comment_launchStatus: launchStatus drives the sitewide banner and the wording on /verify/.
pre-launch : the issuer account exists and is funded but has no account settings, no
Domain, and no issuance. The site states that no $PND exists yet and that
anything trading under the code PND is therefore not $PND.
live       : the issuer has been configured, Domain matches this host, and $PND has
been issued. Only set this after the checks on /verify/ actually pass.
Leave this at pre-launch until the AccountSet and issuance transactions are validated.
Setting it to live early is the one edit on this site that could mislead a buyer.
site.issuerAddressStatus: planned issuer account — funded, not yet configured on ledger
